title:
An epic to update a component's filter and trigger a data request after a delay to ensure component state is properly populated.
Performs the same functionality and uses the same payload arguments as {@link UiSdlEpicUpdateComponentFilter}, with the following additions:
  - filterActionSuffixes: A list containing action suffixes which should be used to determine the right action payload to use for extracting filter values.
  - delayUntilObserveActionSuffixes: A list containing action suffixes which indicate that the epic is safe to emit its output actions.

At least one action with each action suffix listed in the above payload arguments must be triggers for the epic.
name: UiSdlEpicUpdateComponentFilterAfterDelay
